title: State Must Outlive the Future
goal: Retain accumulated data across async calls by mutating struct state instead of creating transient local state.
hints: Mutate the buf field on self directly so the modified data persists on the struct.
extend_from_slice appends a byte slice directly to a Vec<u8>.
explanation: To persist state across async function invocations, mutate `self.buf` directly. Writing `buf` without `self.` causes `E0425` because no local variable exists. Writing `let mut buf` creates local transient state that disappears when the function frame is dropped. Calling `push(chunk)` fails with `E0308` because `push` expects a single `u8`, not a slice.
